fullPassage: Literacy is crucial to the teaching-learning process that occurs in the middle grades because this is when young adolescents begin to move from narrative to expository text, a process that places increasing demands on the students' literacy skills. Unfortunately, despite these increasing demands on their literacy skills, formal reading instruction ends for many young adolescents once they enter middle school. One reason for this is that only about 50 percent of middle-grades teachers receive training in the teaching of literacy, broadly conceived as integrated reading, writing, speaking, and listening. Fewer still receive specific training in programs such as writing across the curriculum. Consequently, many teachers are less than ideally prepared to teach content-area literacy strategies to their students. Given the increasing emphasis on integrated curricula in the middle grades, all teachers, regardless of the subjects they teach, are being called on to integrate the language arts into their subjects.

❌ ② explanatory — 설명하는. expository와 거의 같은 뜻의 동의어라 '가장 먼' 것이 아님
❌ ③ temporary — 일시적인. 글의 종류와 의미축이 전혀 다름
❌ ④ foreign — 외국의. expository와 관련 없는 단어
det.tip: expository(설명적인) ↔ narrative(서사적인). explanatory는 오히려 동의어이므로 함정

questions.passage: Literacy is crucial to the teaching-learning process that occurs in the middle grades because this is when young adolescents begin to move from narrative to expository text, a process that places increasing demands on the students' literacy skills. Unfortunately, despite these increasing demands on their literacy skills, formal reading instruction ends for many young adolescents once they enter middle school. One reason for this is that only about 50 percent of middle-grades teachers receive training in the teaching of literacy, <u>broadly</u> conceived as integrated reading, writing, speaking, and listening. Fewer still receive specific training in programs such as writing across the curriculum. Consequently, many teachers are less than ideally prepared to teach content-area literacy strategies to their students. Given the increasing emphasis on integrated curricula in the middle grades, all teachers, regardless of the subjects they teach, are being called on to integrate the language arts into their subjects.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 broadly의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: broadly(폭넓게) ↔ narrowly(좁게)
det.analysis:
❌ ① widely — 널리, 폭넓게. broadly와 거의 같은 뜻의 동의어라 '가장 먼' 것이 아님
✅ ② narrowly — 좁게, 한정적으로. broadly(폭넓게)의 직접적 반의어로 뜻이 가장 멂
❌ ③ quietly — 조용히. 범위가 아니라 소리와 관련되어 의미축이 다름
❌ ④ quickly — 빠르게. 속도를 뜻하며 broadly와 무관
det.tip: broadly(폭넓게) ↔ narrowly(좁게). widely는 오히려 동의어이므로 함정

questions.passage:
(A) In the middle grades, students begin to move from narrative to expository <u>text</u> that demands stronger reading skills.

(B) Don't worry about the directions — I'll <u>text</u> you the exact address before you leave.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 text의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A)의 text는 '글, 문서' / (B)의 text는 '문자 메시지를 보내다'
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 문자를 보내다 — (B) 글/문서: (A)(B) 의미가 뒤바뀌어 부적절
❌ ② (A) 글/문서 — (B) 교과서: (B) I'll text you의 text는 명사 '교과서'가 아니라 동사 '문자하다'
❌ ③ (A) 시험하다 — (B) 문자를 보내다: (A) expository text의 text는 동사 '시험하다'가 아니라 명사 '글'
✅ ④ (A) 글/문서 — (B) 문자를 보내다: (A) expository text = 설명적 글 / (B) I'll text you = 너에게 문자할게
det.tip: text의 다의: ① 글, 문서(expository text) ② 문자 메시지를 보내다(I'll text you)

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the subjects that are included in a course of study at a school or college"

det.korean: 학교나 대학의 교육과정에 포함된 과목들 → curriculum(교육과정)
det.analysis:
✅ ① curriculum — 교육과정. 학교에서 가르치는 과목들의 전체 구성이라는 정의에 정확히 부합
❌ ② semester — 학기. 기간을 뜻하며 과목 구성과 다름
❌ ③ diploma — 졸업장. 자격 증서를 뜻하며 정의와 무관
❌ ④ faculty — 교수진. 사람(교원 집단)을 뜻하며 과목과 다름
det.tip: curriculum = 교육과정. writing across the curriculum = 교육과정 전반에 걸친 쓰기

questions.passage: Literacy is crucial to the teaching-learning process that occurs in the middle grades. This is a process that __________ (place) increasing demands on the students' literacy skills.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 관계대명사 that의 선행사가 단수(a process)이므로 3인칭 단수 현재형 → places
det.analysis: 정답: places — 관계대명사 that의 선행사가 단수 명사 process이고 현재 시제이므로 동사원형 place에 -s를 붙여 3인칭 단수형 places로 써야 함. a process that places increasing demands = 늘어나는 요구를 부과하는 과정
det.tip: 선행사 a process(단수) + 현재 시제 → 관계절 동사 places(3인칭 단수)

questions.passage: Fewer teachers receive specific training in programs such as writing across the curriculum. Consequently, many teachers are less than ideally __________ (prepare) to teach content-area literacy strategies to their students.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: be동사(are) 뒤에서 '준비되어 있다'는 수동·상태를 나타내므로 과거분사 → prepared
det.analysis: 정답: prepared — 'be동사(are) + 과거분사' 형태로 '준비되어 있다'는 수동·상태 의미를 나타내야 하므로 prepare를 과거분사 prepared로 바꿔야 함. are less than ideally prepared = 이상적으로 준비되어 있지는 못하다
det.tip: are + p.p.(prepared) = ~되어 있다. 상태를 나타내는 수동 형태

One reason for this is that only about 50 percent of middle-grades teachers receive training in the teaching of literacy, broadly conceived as integrated reading, writing, speaking, and listening. Fewer still receive specific training in programs such as writing __________. Consequently, many teachers are less than ideally prepared to teach content-area literacy strategies to their students. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸=across the curriculum(교육과정 전반에 걸친) — 쓰기 훈련이 이루어지는 범위
det.analysis:
❌ ① for entertainment — 오락을 위한. 학문적 훈련 프로그램이라는 맥락과 무관
❌ ② in their free time — 여가 시간에. 정식 훈련 프로그램과 어긋남
✅ ③ across the curriculum — 교육과정 전반에 걸친. 'writing across the curriculum'은 모든 교과에서 쓰기를 가르치는 프로그램을 가리키는 표현으로 맥락에 정확히 부합
❌ ④ without any effort — 아무 노력 없이. 특정 훈련이라는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: programs such as writing across the curriculum = 교육과정 전반에 걸친 쓰기 같은 프로그램

questions.passage: Literacy is crucial to the teaching-learning process that occurs in the middle grades because this is when young adolescents begin to move from narrative to expository text, a process that places increasing demands on the students' literacy skills. Unfortunately, despite these increasing demands on their literacy skills, formal reading instruction ends for many young adolescents once they enter middle school. One reason for this is that only about 50 percent of middle-grades teachers receive training in the teaching of literacy, broadly conceived as integrated reading, writing, speaking, and listening. Fewer still receive specific training in programs such as writing across the curriculum. Consequently, many teachers are less than ideally prepared to teach content-area literacy strategies to their students. Given the increasing emphasis on integrated curricula in the middle grades, all teachers, __________, are being called on to integrate the language arts into their subjects.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸=regardless of the subjects they teach(그들이 가르치는 과목에 관계없이) — 모든 교사에게 요구되는 조건
det.analysis:
❌ ① only if they teach English — 영어를 가르칠 때만. 뒤에 '모든 교사'가 언어 기능을 통합하라는 맥락과 모순
✅ ② regardless of the subjects they teach — 가르치는 과목에 관계없이. 'all teachers ~ integrate the language arts into their subjects'로, 과목에 상관없이 모든 교사가 요구받는다는 흐름에 정확히 부합
❌ ③ after they retire — 은퇴한 뒤에. 현직 교사에게 요구되는 맥락과 무관
❌ ④ during summer break — 여름 방학 동안. 특정 시기로 한정할 근거가 없어 부적절
det.tip: all teachers, regardless of the subjects they teach = 가르치는 과목에 관계없이 모든 교사
